Interface PasswordlessLoginMethod

All Known Implementing Classes:
EmailLinkLoginMethod, OidcLoginMethod, PasskeyLoginMethod
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface PasswordlessLoginMethod
A way to sign in to a browser session, contributed as a bean by a credential module (email links, passkeys, ...). WhoWebSecurity.passwordless() and WhoSecurity.all() apply every such bean, in @Order order, to the chain they configure.

    • publicPaths

      default Set<String> publicPaths()
      Returns the paths a signed-out browser must reach to sign in this way, such as the endpoint that sends a sign-in link. WhoPublicPaths collects them for the chain's permitAll().
      Returns:
      path patterns, empty by default

    • humanCheckedPaths

      default Map<String,String> humanCheckedPaths()
      Returns the paths whose POSTs the application's WhoHumanCheck, when it has one, must pass first, each mapped to the action the check is told, such as email-send. Only endpoints a signed-out caller can use to make the application do something costly belong here.
      Returns:
      full paths mapped to actions, empty by default

    • name

      default String name()
      Returns this method's name, for the line who logs at startup naming the sign-in methods a chain accepts. who's own methods return a short name such as passkey.
      Returns:
      the name; by default the class's simple name, or for an anonymous class or a lambda a name built from its enclosing class
